product_metadata.title: HBlife Tension Curtain Rod 57-98 inches, Never Rust Non-Slip Spring Tension Curtain Rod No Drilling Stainless Steel Curtain Rod Use Bathroom Kitchen Home
features: Never Rust: spring tension shower curtain rod Made by 304 stainless steel Which is High-Corrosion Resistance and Easy Cleaning
Non-Fall Down: spring Tension Rod And Rubber Suction Cup—no need to worry about it slipping or falling down, even after connecting a curtain.Max Load reaches up to 20 pounds

Easy To Install: This adjustable shower rods extends from 57 to 98 inches, The Tension rod installs quickly and easily,expand or shrink easily by rotating the shower rod —no drilling, screws, or tools required.

Apply For All Surface : It can be applied on all surfaces include both of smooth and rough surface like wallpaper, paint wall, tile wall, wooden frame, Etc. Large rubber plate will not scratch or damage the installation surface. Remove cleanly.

Multipurpose: The shower tension rod can also be used in other areas of the home,such as bathroom, kitchen, bedroom, balcony.Use it to hang privacy curtains in a doorway or blackout curtains in a bedroom window.
description: High quality shower curtain rod made of 304 stainless steel will keep clean and bright without rust Our heavy-duty tension rods present a creative and easy way to hang curtains in minutes. No drilling required. Simply adjust the curtain rods to the size of your space and let the spring loaded tension do the rest!

1, choosing the size that best fits your space,make sure the width of the spring bar to be installed. 2,Holding the rod in both hands, push the spring level out of the rod in a rotating way, Continue to twist the rod until it’s longer than the opening by 1 or 2 inches (depending on the size). 3, pull it back to create tension ,adjust the level to a suitable horizontal position.

1,pls don’t rotate the bath bar after installation. 2,pls use it within the load-bearing limit. 3,Max weight:10kg/22lb 4,The length is adjustable to be 2-3 inches longer than the width to be mounted5, do not wipe the surface of the product with strong acid and alkali cleaning fluid to avoid oxidation
